# Vendored motion library

- **Library:** Motion for JavaScript (`motion`)
- **Version:** 14.6.0
- **File:** `motion.js` (`dist/motion.js`, UMD build, minified)
- **Source:** https://www.npmjs.com/package/motion
- **License:** MIT, copyright Motion B.V. See `motion.LICENSE.md`.

The file is checked in so the site keeps its `script-src 'self'` Content
Security Policy and works without a third-party CDN or a build step.
